description: This file implements higher-level logic for saving and reading configuration data to/from internal flash memory in an embedded engine control system. It manages flash memory address calculations, CRC validation, configuration reset, and command registration for flash operations.

methods.name: flashStateCrc
methods.description: Calculates CRC of the persistent configuration state for integrity verification.

methods.name: setNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Flags that a configuration write is scheduled.

methods.name: getNeedToWriteConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a configuration write is pending.

methods.name: writeToFlashIfPending
methods.description: Triggers flash write if a pending request exists.

methods.name: writeToFlashNow
methods.description: Performs immediate writing of configuration data to flash memory with CRC calculation and verification.

methods.name: isValidCrc
methods.description: Verifies the CRC of the configuration data in flash.

methods.name: doResetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the configuration to default settings based on engine type.

methods.name: doReadConfiguration
methods.description: Reads and validates configuration data from a specified flash address.

methods.name: readConfiguration
methods.description: Attempts to read configuration from primary and secondary flash addresses, handling CRC and version mismatches, and applies configuration if valid.

methods.name: readFromFlash
methods.description: Public method to initiate configuration reading process.

methods.name: rewriteConfig
methods.description: Resets configuration and writes it to flash.

methods.name: initFlash
methods.description: Initializes flash subsystem and registers console commands.
